Question 17

The position vector r of a particle P (relative to a fixed origin O) at time t is given by r=⟨ln⁡(t+1),2t4+3⟩,t>0. Calculate the acceleration vector a at time t=1.

a
a(1)=⟨12,12⟩
b
a(1)=⟨−14,12⟩
c
a(1)=⟨12,16⟩
d
a(1)=⟨−12,24⟩
e
a(1)=⟨−14,24⟩
